P1.label: Play → next play
P1.note: Next-play success after a success vs after a failure, beyond the shuffle.

P2.label: Drive → our next drive
P2.note: Points over expected on the next drive, per point over expected on this one.

P3.label: Our drive → their next drive
P3.note: Momentum says a great drive makes our defense better next series: a negative slope.

P4.label: Fumble bounce
P4.note: Swing in the next two possessions when the bounce goes to the defense instead of the offense.

big.label: After a 4th-down conversion
big.note: Next play after a 4th-down conversion vs after a 3rd-down conversion.

stakes.label: High stakes vs low stakes
stakes.note: Carryover after the 20% of snaps with the most at stake minus the 20% with the least.

crowd.label: Home offense vs away offense
crowd.note: If the crowd feeds momentum, the home team should carry over more.

empty.label: 2020 empty stadiums
empty.note: Home-minus-away carryover in 2020 minus 2019 and 2021. Crowd momentum predicts it drops.

halftime.label: Halftime reset
halftime.note: Drive carryover with no break minus across halftime. A reset predicts positive.

P2_sr_sum.label: Drive → our next drive (successful plays)
P2_sr_sum.note: The same drive-to-drive test, counting successful plays (or EPA) instead of points.

P2_epa_oe.label: Drive → our next drive (EPA)
P2_epa_oe.note: The same drive-to-drive test, counting successful plays (or EPA) instead of points.
